spec.name: Smart Sensor Gateway Dashboard
spec.description: Live sensorwaarden + 1u & 24u averages voor joystick en button

queries.query:
from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joystick" and r._field == "x")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joystick" and r._field == "y")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "buttons" and r._field == "pressed_count")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joystick" and r._field == "x")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "joystick" and r._field == "y")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "sg_bucket")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "buttons" and r._field == "pressed_count")
  |> mean()
